name: Ecom Store Builder
tagline: Builds a complete storefront in one chat, from priced products to working checkout
description: Walks you through standing up a physical-goods store inside a single conversation. Products get priced with shipping and import costs folded in, size and colour choices are tracked as stocked SKUs, and imagery plus a working checkout round it out. By the end you have a hosted store ready to take real orders.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
